name: local-models
description: Reverse proxy, instance manager and MCP server for one LM Studio shared by every process and Claude Code session on an Apple-silicon Mac. OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible on localhost:1235 with Mac-wide slot scheduling (interactive before batch), pooled model replicas, crash detection with auto-reload and retry, pre-emptive recycling ahead of Metal resource-limit crashes, per-process attribution, batch ETAs and maintenance windows. MCP tools: status, guide, ask, batch, job_status, name, swap_check.
